claims.statement: The CBAM definitive regime applies from 1 January 2026; covered importers above the stated mass threshold must obtain authorised-declarant status, declare embedded emissions, and surrender certificates.
The Commission's 2026 verification timeline provides for accredited verifiers to issue reports that operators share with declarants through the CBAM Registry.

contrary_evidence: The official registry already handles declarations and verification-report exchange, limiting value to upstream evidence operations.
Customs and ESG suites can extend into this workflow.

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: permissioned reuse of producer-installation evidence and a growing map of supplier data exceptions
fingerprint.customer: EU customs brokers and mid-market importers of covered steel, aluminium, cement, fertiliser, hydrogen, or electricity goods
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: customs-broker and indirect-representative channels that reach many importers
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: white-label supplier portal, evidence validation, version control, allocation engine, and declaration-ready export
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: the importer or broker pays for account access and each covered declaration line
fingerprint.problem_trigger: a covered customs line arrives without reusable, verified embedded-emissions evidence

founder_fit: Strong quantitative and automation fit, with asynchronous partner distribution and clear per-shipment value; a single commodity corridor can validate demand part-time.
risks: Never claim verifier status; accredited verification remains external.
Method changes can invalidate calculation logic.
Cross-border supplier data may be incomplete or commercially sensitive.

structure.control_point: the emissions evidence packet bound to the authorised declarant's annual CBAM declaration
structure.critical_dependency: credible installation-level emissions data and verification outputs from non-EU producers

thesis: A customs-broker-distributed exchange can request, validate, version, and reuse installation-level embedded-emissions evidence from non-EU suppliers, then bind it to importer declarations. Each covered shipment and annual declaration is a paid event; shared supplier records create a network advantage without the founder becoming the verifier.
title: CBAM Supplier Evidence Exchange for Customs Intermediaries
